rule.text: Highest first-window mean lead over the average liquid stock, among versions with enough picks and a positive mean after a 0.49% round trip; within 0.05 points the one with fewer rules. The second window is printed whatever it shows.

month.what: The month list refuses a stock with no industry, and the replay handed the engine NSE's list as it stands today, so it could pick only companies in that list. Beside the lead over every liquid stock, its records measure the lead over the liquid stocks in that list: vs_eligible_pct (after the round trip, vs_eligible_net_pct; Newey-West t, vs_eligible_t) and lists_ahead_of_eligible_pct, with member_premium_pct, how far their average ran ahead of every liquid stock's over the same list dates, per hold. Reported beside the rule, never used by it.

long.what: On every long list date from its first window to the end of the data. companies: the liquid companies listed a year that the engine ranks for the long list, less the ones it judges as lenders (a company with no filings counts as none, as the list reads it); with_filings: how many of them had any filing visible that session; and for each check, how many had its figure. most_from is the first list date a figure was known for at least half of them, first_pct and second_pct its mean share known over each window's list dates.
